scopes.note: 28 GCC jump-table shapes and one signature match

assumptions.name: Only declared image entries execute; code is immutable
assumptions.retire: model code writes (self-modifying code, overlay loads) and prove every executable byte's origin

assumptions.name: Interrupts, exceptions, DMA, MMIO, overlays, RSP and external entries are excluded from analysis
assumptions.retire: model them in the closure proof, or prove the HLE runtime equivalent; the runtime stands in for them today

assumptions.name: 32-bit address model
assumptions.retire: model 64-bit addressing and the full TLB, or prove the game never leaves the 32-bit subset

assumptions.name: Register calls reach only address-taken functions (1,341 in SM64)
assumptions.retire: prove each indirect site's target set by data flow, jump-table shape or points-to

assumptions.name: Forwarded runtime-callback wrappers are entered only by their direct callers (ADR-0149)
assumptions.retire: prove the callback target at each wrapper call site

assumptions.name: Return closure: each jr ra returns to its caller's continuation
assumptions.retire: prove return targets per function, including tail calls and stack-slot integrity

assumptions.name: Guarded RAM data access: aligned RDRAM through KSEG0/KSEG1 or runtime-written TLB entries, no stores into code
assumptions.retire: prove each load and store address range

assumptions.name: Jump tables are read-only
assumptions.retire: prove table immutability and target identity (pointer_table blockers)

assumptions.name: COP1 usable with FR=0 (declared with --fr0)
assumptions.retire: model Status.CU1 and Status.FR, or prove them from the game's own writes

assumptions.name: COP1 stays in the modelled subset: no NaN, subnormal, out-of-range conversion or FPU exception
assumptions.retire: model FPU exceptions and the remaining operand classes

assumptions.name: Declared loads place their bytes before the code runs
assumptions.retire: derive the loads from the ROM instead of declaring them by hand

assumptions.name: libultra runtime functions are host-provided (HLE)
assumptions.retire: differential-test each HLE function against the game's own libultra; only scenario tests exist today

assumptions.name: Three runtime names come only from a reference symbol map (osInitialize, osContInit, osEepromLongRead; ADR-0171)
assumptions.retire: identify them from the ROM's own bytes

hand_inputs: Code segment ROM offset, address, size and entry point, given by hand
--loads files for executable loads, written by hand (SM64: 2, OoT: 2)
SM64 function identification uses a local decomp map
RSP microcode comes from IMEM snapshots taken by running the game
Graphics are drawn by RT64 from display lists (high-level emulation)
libultra runs as a host runtime (HLE)
